title: Sweet speech without humility is still performance.
summary: Guru pairs tender speech with bowed conduct for a reason. One without the other can still be ego in ceremonial dress.
takeaway: Tone matters most when posture has changed with it.
lifeApplication: Choose a lower posture today, not just a softer sentence.

source.shortMeaning: Saint company and humble speech belong together.
source.lifeApplication: Do not try to sound transformed while still standing on self-importance.

evidence.coreClaim: Saint company and humble speech belong together.
evidence.turn: Soft speech becomes believable when the ego has begun to bow.
evidence.practicalImplication: Choose a lower posture today, not just a softer sentence.
